_help: Items. 'category' is weapon, armor, gear, tool, magic or other. Weapons need 'weapon' stats; armor needs 'armor' stats ('dexMax': null = full Dex, 0 = no Dex, 2 = up to +2). Magic items use category 'magic' and a 'magic' block; a weapon or armor with its own stats can also have a 'magic' block. 'magic.effects' lists what the item grants while equipped (and attuned, if required), using the same effect types as feats.

items._help: Magic weapon variant: when added in the inventory, the app asks which weapon it enchants. 'bonus' adds to attack/damage rolls.
items.name: Hearth Blade +1
items.description: This weapon glows like embers. You have a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with it.

items._help: Worn magic item: works once equipped (and attuned if 'attunement' is true). 'bonus.ac' / 'bonus.save' add to AC and all saves; 'abilitySet' sets a score to at least that value; 'charges' adds a charge tracker.
items.name: Amulet of the Oak
items.description: While wearing this amulet your Constitution score is 17, and you gain a +1 bonus to saving throws. It has 3 charges; spend one to cast Barkskin. It regains its charges at dawn.

items._help: A weapon with its own stats that is also magic: the 'magic.bonus' attack and damage apply to it directly. No need to pick a base weapon.
items.name: Emberbrand
items.description: A longsword whose blade is etched with runes of fire. You have a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with it.

items._help: Worn magic item that grants effects: here cold resistance and a spell it can cast. The spell shows on the sheet with the item's name and the 'note'. Other effect types work too: speedBonus, speedMode, darkvision, skill, save, language, abilityBonus, hpBonus, initiativeBonus.
items.name: Frostfire Pendant
items.description: While wearing this pendant you have Resistance to Cold damage. It has 2 charges; spend one to cast Ice Knife. It regains its charges at dawn.
